text.en: This Order may be cited as the Emergency (Legal Profession Act) Citation. (Amendment) Order, 1987 and shall come into force with effect from 1st January, 1988.

The Legal Profession Act is amended in subsection ( 1) of section Amendment of 14 by deleting the full-stop at the end of paragraph (b) and substituting Section 14. therefor a comma and the word "and" and adding the following new paragraph (c) - "(c) unless he is or is about to be ordinarily resident in Brunei''. Made this 24th day of September, 1987 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
